subject.title: Feature Request: Skill-Driven Plugin Context Visibility (activates.plugins)

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `metadata.openclaw.activates.plugins` skill contract for per-turn plugin tool visibility, or keep broad catalog compaction owned by Tool Search and static tool policy?
rationale: This changes public skill metadata and request-time tool visibility semantics across skills, plugin tooling, prompt assembly, and security policy; source inspection shows no existing contract to extend mechanically without choosing the product/API direction first.

options.title: Approve activation design
options.body: Define `activates.plugins` semantics, precedence, and compatibility rules before implementing parser, snapshot, tool-planning, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Defer to Tool Search
options.body: Keep this issue as context for Tool Search improvements if maintainers prefer catalog search over skill-driven plugin activation.

options.title: Fold into skill graph work
options.body: Move the product decision into a broader skill-dependency or context-loading design so related proposals do not create competing contracts.

recommendation.title: Approve activation design
recommendation.body: Define `activates.plugins` semantics, precedence, and compatibility rules before implementing parser, snapshot, tool-planning, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans product/runtime boundaries and the recent history around skill loading, tool assembly, and conversation capability planning routes through steipete's current-main work.
